This size 7 engagement ring features a 1.22 ct round clear cubic zirconia center stone in a halo setting. The rhodium-plated 925 sterling silver band is 3mm wide and decorated with micro-pavé stones. It is hypoallergenic, nickel-free, and comes packaged in a leather box.

This anime-themed wallet case for iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max is made of TPU and PU leather. It features three card slots, a cash slot, an auto wake/sleep function, and a multi-angle stand. The shockproof design protects against scratches and drops while providing easy access to all buttons and ports.

specs.Compatibility: Casement, tilting, and bottom hung windows

record.description: This 158-inch waterproof nylon window seal is designed for casement, tilting, and bottom-hung windows. It uses adhesive hook tape and a zipper to secure portable air conditioner or tumble dryer hoses, blocking outside air from entering the room. The kit is washable, easy to install without drilling, and fits various hose diameters.

This 19” x 24” dish drying mat features a low-profile design and absorbent polyester fabric with a waterproof, slip-resistant backing. It protects countertops from scratches and spills while providing a surface for drying various kitchen items. The mat is machine washable, durable, and made in the USA using over 50% recycled fibers.

The Jiee Tec SUNTEK Solar Panel provides 9V backup power for Suntek series hunting trail cameras. It features a safeguard circuit to protect against overloads, an IP 65 waterproof rating, and a deep color. This portable unit can be mounted on trees, poles, or tripods for outdoor use.

These black Russell Athletic men's mesh shorts feature a 9-inch inseam and an X-Large size. They are constructed with breathable mesh and Dri-Power moisture-wicking technology. The shorts include an elastic waistband with an internal draw cord for an adjustable fit and side pockets for small items.

This white long-sleeve blouse by Romwe features a slim fit and a ribbed knit texture. It is designed with a cross wrap style and an asymmetrical neckline. Made from a polyester, cotton, and spandex blend, this pullover top is machine washable and suitable for various casual outfits.

These clip-on heel wheels attach to regular shoes to create roller skates for children aged 6 and up. They feature battery-free LEDs that light up as the wheels rotate. The adjustable design supports up to 132 lbs and includes a rubber strap and large brakes for safety.

specs.Compatible Surfaces: Plastic, whiteboard, glass, paper, wood, metal, ceramic

record.description: This white matte Chartpak Graphic Art Tape measures 1/8 inch wide by 324 inches long. It features a permanent adhesive suitable for indoor and outdoor use on surfaces like wood, metal, glass, and paper. It is designed for creating solid lines on crafts, charts, and signage.

specs.Dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H Inches

record.description: This wood toddler bed from Delta Children features a Nick Jr. PAW Patrol design. Suitable for children aged 15 months and older, it includes two high side rails for safety. The JPMA-certified bed measures 54.53 x 29.92 x 18.90 inches and is designed for easy assembly.

This set includes two ivory sheer curtain panels, each measuring 52 by 84 inches. Made from linen-textured fabric, these curtains feature a grommet top and a 0.4-inch bottom hem. They allow light and airflow into a room while providing privacy. These machine-washable panels are suitable for various living spaces.

This 11 x 14 inch Amazon Basics whiteboard features a magnetic dry erase surface and a lightweight aluminum frame. It includes a black marker with a built-in eraser, two magnets, and self-stick pads for mounting. The board can be hung horizontally or vertically to display notes, lists, or photos.

This 12-piece set includes five sandwich bags, five snack bags, two large storage bags, and two sealing clips. Made from food-grade PEVA, these transparent, BPA-free bags are freezer-safe and leak-proof. They are suitable for storing food, snacks, and other items. Hand wash and air dry after use. Do not use in a microwave, oven, or dishwasher.

This Carter's 7-pack contains long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in size 18M. The set features assorted colors and patterns. Each bodysuit includes strong snaps designed for durability during regular wear and washing.

specs.Key Ingredients: Amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, hyaluronic acid
specs.Allergen-Free: Free of soy, nuts, fish, and shellfish

record.description: PlantFusion Collagen Builder is a vegan, gluten-free vanilla protein powder designed to support collagen production, skin hydration, and joint health. It contains amla fruit extract, proline, glycine, and hyaluronic acid. This non-GMO formula is free from dairy, soy, and common allergens, and can be mixed into smoothies or coffee.

specs.Fragrance Notes: Pumpkin puree, sweet butter, vanilla cream

record.description: This set includes six Bath & Body Works Sweet Cinnamon Pumpkin Wallflower refill bulbs, packaged as three twin-packs. The fragrance features notes of pumpkin puree, sweet butter, and vanilla cream. These bulbs are compatible with Wallflower Fragrance Plugs and Night-Lights. This is a discontinued item.

specs.Included Items: Candy, Cookies, Chocolates, Wafers, Biscuits, Pretzels

record.description: This snack box contains at least eight pre-packaged treats from various Eastern European countries, including Russia, Romania, and Croatia. The assortment may include candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. Each box features a unique variety of authentic snacks produced in the region.

specs.Compatibility: Universal manual and automatic vehicles without buttons

record.description: This black skull-shaped gear shifter knob is made from resin and aluminum alloy. It is designed for most manual and automatic vehicles without buttons. The package includes three adapters for 8mm to 12mm shifter levers, a spanner, and four screws to facilitate installation.

This Z-synka set includes 200 ivory plastic pearls in three sizes: 20mm, 14mm, and 10mm. These no-hole pearls feature a polished finish and are suitable for use as vase fillers or table scatter. The kit also includes six packets of transparent water gels designed to make the pearls float for various decorations.

specs.Included Items: Modes Bassinet Stroller, SnugRide SnugLock 35 Infant Car Seat

record.description: The Graco Modes Bassinet Travel System in Wynton includes a stroller that converts into an infant bassinet, an infant car seat carrier, and a toddler stroller. It also comes with a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat. The system offers nine riding options and a one-step attachment for the car seat.

This white, hi-grade plastic tray is designed to hold 24-inch flower boxes. It is lightweight and fade-resistant, providing a protective surface for decks, patios, or indoor areas. Measuring 22.25 inches long by 6.5 inches wide, this tray is made in the USA.

This light blue undershelf storage basket features a steel metal frame with a rust-resistant PE finish. It includes snug fit arms designed to attach to cabinets, desks, or other shelves to create additional storage space. The medium-sized basket measures 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches and weighs 12 ounces.

This 24k gold-plated heart locket measures 0.75" x 0.5" and holds up to two photos. It is available as a standalone pendant or with an 18-inch curb link chain. Made in the USA, the piece comes in a black velvet pouch and includes a lifetime replacement guarantee.

specs.Nib: 23 K Gold Plated Steel Fine Nib

record.description: This Kaweco fountain pen is made of high-quality brass and features a 23 K gold-plated steel fine nib. It weighs 21 grams and measures 13 cm with the cap attached. Handmade in Nuremberg, this pocket-sized pen is designed to provide a soft writing experience.

These blue volume lash extensions from WENDY LASHES feature a 0.07mm thickness and lengths ranging from 14-20mm. They include sticky roots to prevent fan separation and have been heat-treated for stable curls. These lashes are designed for creating 4D to 10D styles and are suitable for beginners.

This weathered white wall-mounted coat rack by Ilyapa features five metal hooks on a distressed wood base. Measuring 24 by 4.5 inches, it has a 30-pound weight capacity. The product includes mounting hardware and is suitable for organizing coats, hats, and bags in various areas of the home.

specs.compatibility: Fishing, hunting, and duck hunting waders

record.description: This stainless steel wader hanger features a chain design capable of supporting over 200 pounds. It allows fishing and hunting waders to hang off the ground, promoting faster drying and helping the gear maintain its shape to extend its service life.

specs.Exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture

record.description: This Spyder men's jacket is constructed from 100% polyester. It features a bonded fleece exterior with a grid knit texture and a Sherpa fleece lining. The design includes a full zip closure, two side zipper pockets, and embroidered branding on the front and back.

These pet stairs are suitable for small, medium, and large dogs to reach elevated surfaces. They are made from blow-molded plastic and feature a removable carpet tread for cleaning. The design includes a slight incline to decrease the total number of steps required.

specs.Functions: Black ballpoint, red ballpoint, pencil, stylus, eraser

record.description: This satin black Cross Tech3+ multifunction pen features a chrome clip and banding. It includes a black ballpoint, a red ballpoint, a 0.5mm pencil, a stylus, and an eraser. The pen offers up to 25 characters of custom silver-toned engraving and comes with a lifetime mechanical warranty in a gift box.

This black short-sleeve t-shirt features the "Raider True 'Til The Day I'm Through" design. Made by Smack Apparel Inc., the garment is constructed from 100% pre-shrunk cotton and is machine washable. It is screen printed in the USA and is available in size X-Large.

specs.Footbed: Soft EVA with anatomical arch support

record.description: These aqua and green sandals for little kids feature a soft EVA footbed with anatomical arch support. They are constructed with flexible Flex Triple Density EVA and a vegan leather upper strap with a jersey lining. The molded high-density EVA outsole provides multi-directional traction.

specs.Details: Mesh inserts under arms, woven crest

record.description: This white adidas kids' Real Madrid 2019-20 home jersey features a regular fit with a straight silhouette. It is made from 100% recycled polyester doubleknit and includes sweat-wicking Climalite fabric with mesh underarm inserts. The jersey has a crewneck, short sleeves, and a woven team crest.
This Hyperkin cable connects Saturn consoles to HDTVs, supporting 720p resolution for clear audio and video. The set includes a 7 ft. main cable and a 6 ft. micro cable.

These replacement lenses are designed to fit Oakley Holbrook sunglasses with model numbers starting with OO9102 in the 55mm size. They feature a dark silver mirror coating with 6% light transmission. The 1.4 mm thick lenses are polarized and provide UV protection meeting ANSI Z80.3 standards. The frame is not included.

specs.Support Features: Arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

record.description: The Bionica Nimah thong sandal features fabric straps and a soft nubuck toe post. It includes a quick-drying molded EVA footbed with arch support, a heel cup, and a toe bar. The design is completed with a shock-absorbing EVA midsole and a durable, slip-resistant rubber outsole.

This jumbo pet bowl by JW Pet Company is designed for extra large dogs. It features a heavyweight construction and a rubber bottom to prevent sliding on tile or linoleum. The bowl is dishwasher safe and available in various colors.

This officially licensed LEGO Batman grid wall poster by Trends International measures 22.375" x 34". Printed on FSC-certified gloss poster paper, the unframed high-resolution artwork is suitable for various rooms and can be displayed using poster mounts, clips, or a frame.

This three-pack of Carter's toddler tank tops for boys features three different designs in blue, orange, and gray. The sleeveless shirts include a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. These 3T tops are made with tagless packaging for comfortable everyday wear.

This pack contains 75 BOX USA double wall Gaylord bottom boxes measuring 48" L x 40" W x 36" H. Made from 275# D.W./ECT-48 kraft corrugated material, these boxes are designed to consolidate shipments of bulky or irregularly shaped items. They are compatible with BGAYLORDLIDHD lids and ship flat.

specs.charging: External USB port and headphone hole

record.description: This black Seoky Rop sling bag is made from water-resistant PU leather and features adjustable nylon straps. It includes multiple compartments, an anti-theft interlayer, an external USB charging port, and a headphone hole. The bag measures 13.8 x 6.7 x 3.2 inches and weighs 0.69 lb.

This 5.5-inch resin figure by Willow Tree depicts an older woman and a young girl sitting on a bench. Hand-painted in cream and gray, the piece is based on an original carving by Susan Lordi. It includes an enclosure card and comes in a fitted box for display on a shelf, table, or mantel.

The Leatherman Surge is a heavy-duty stainless steel multitool equipped with 21 tools, including large pliers and a blade exchanger. It features one-hand opening, all-locking mechanisms, and replaceable wire cutters. This tool includes a premium nylon sheath and is covered by a 25-year warranty.

This white short-sleeved chef's jacket for women features a double-breasted design with a 10-button closure. It can be worn in two different ways and includes a matching chef hat. The hat features velcro fasteners to fit sizes XS to XXL. This set is size small.

DiNeop 3MM neoprene gloves provide warmth and protection for water activities such as snorkeling, kayaking, and surfing. They feature a flexible, form-fitting design with an anti-slip palm and an adjustable velcro strap. These durable, high-stretch gloves are suitable for men, women, and children.

specs.Care: Machine washable cold, tumble dry low

record.description: WallFlower Women's Juniors denim shortalls in Belle are designed with adjustable straps and a center zipper closure. These size small shortalls feature a 3-inch cuffed inseam, multiple pockets, and LYCRA fabric. They are machine washable in cold water and safe for low tumble drying.

The LENTION CB-C31 is a space gray USB-C hub featuring four USB 3.0 ports with data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps. It includes a Type-C port supporting up to 60W power delivery. This aluminum alloy adapter is compatible with various laptops, including MacBook Pro, Surface, and Chromebooks, and requires no external drivers.

This official Alex Grey poster features the "Oversoul" artwork. Measuring 18 by 24 inches, this museum-quality print illustrates the theme of human consciousness as a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness.

The ALPS Mountaineering Low Rocker Chair features a powder-coated steel frame and breathable TechMesh fabric. This foldable chair includes a shoulder bag for transport and supports up to 300 pounds. It measures 22" W x 17" D x 31" H and weighs 11 lbs.

This pack of two Size D batteries is official merchandise from Trick Or Treat Studios and Universal Studios. Based on onscreen and behind-the-scenes footage from Child's Play 2, these batteries are designed as an accessory for a Good Guys Doll.
